name: shell_ref
purpose: PROPOSAL, not to be run until K says so: one shell-hold reference run at tiles 1 (shell fold imposed, loops held toward it), same yarn settings as fidelity, for comparison with the yarn-only arms.

estimate.basis: relax part: same as the yarn-only tiles-1 run, 5.2 min by the formula to 6.4 min corrected (the old jobs show the shell hold adds no cost per round: tiles 3, outer 15, maxiter 200: 237 s per outer round with the shell, 234 s without). Start-up part: the old tiles-3 shell jobs spent 290 to 620 s before the first outer round, of which the shell stage was 278 s for 2880 stitches; tiles 1 has 9x fewer stitches, so the shell stage is expected near 30 s (EXTRAPOLATED, scaling with size unknown) and the tile analysis (a few minutes per the job log) is cached in scripts/cell_cache/tile_kappa_cache.json if the cache key matches, otherwise it adds a few minutes (UNSOURCED).
estimate.note: Not run. The old shell-hold job in webui/results/20261031-191813 was the full 60 x 48 stitch fabric; its entry 6 (outer 20, maxiter 200) took 5117 s.

sourced: relax.E 3700 MPa: Kharkova et al. 2011 (webui/main.py CONFIG)
relax.tension 10 cN: lowest of the 10/20/30 cN cotton values in the Mechanika study cited in webui/main.py
unsourced: relax.mu 0.49, relax.ei 0.25, relax.stretch_law 0.01:80,0.03:200,0.06:330, relax.length_ratio 0.95, relax.straight 0.05, relax.curl 0.01 (copied from the last real job, webui/results/20261031-191813/job_request.json; provenance not recorded; CLAUDE.md says the yarn EA/EI/stretch curve is still to be measured)
relax.shell_w 1.0 (webui CONFIG: 'numerical choice, not tested on the real solver')
seed_stitch is omitted: relax_job.py refuses --seed-stitch together with --shell
